verdict.gate: 5a-KS may not contribute a number to the manuscript, and the rung may not be priced from a leg rate alone, until this qualifies.

price.projection_basis: linear particle-count scaling from the benchmark's 27809 particles to 146284 (NR4A ternary leg) and ~35000 (binary leg). Linear-in-particles is the standard first-order assumption for PME MD at fixed cutoff; it is an ASSUMPTION, not a measurement, and the projected wedge cost is therefore a PROJECTION — it may not be quoted as a measured rate.
